WB01.description: 135 km/h winds and 3.5m storm surge breached island ring embankments, submerging southern agricultural land.
WB01.outcome: 22,000 evacuated to MPCS cyclone shelters; NDRF motorboats mobilized.

WB01.description: Astronomical high tide synchronized with 2.8m surge overtopping river dikes across Sagar Block.
WB01.outcome: Relief air-drops via Coast Guard ALH; saline water pumps deployed.

WB01.description: Category 5 equivalent landfall. Catastrophic tree uprooting, telecommunication tower collapse, 90% power grid destroyed.
WB01.outcome: Army and NDRF restored lifeline roads; restoration took weeks.

WB02.description: Storm surge submerged Kakdwip fish landing center and damaged harbor jetties.
Severe gale winds tore off tin roofs across market complexes and snapped NH 12 feeder roads.
WB02.outcome: SDRF rapid clearing of tree debris.

WB04.description: Direct marine surge inundated Henry Island and Bakkhali beach resorts under 2 meters of seawater.
WB04.outcome: Total coastal evacuation to concrete MPCS.

WB04.description: Eye of cyclone passed near Bakkhali; coastal casuarina plantation devastated.

WB05.description: Bidhyadhari and Matla river saline breaches submerged freshwater ponds across Gosaba island.
WB05.outcome: Mobile RO water purification units dispatched by boat.

WB05.description: Saline ingress ruined fertile paddy fields across 8 Gram Panchayats.

WB03.description: Heavy cyclonic downpours (>190mm) inundated low-lying areas of Namkhana Delta Sector.
WB03.outcome: Community shelters activated; civil defense relief provided.

WB03.description: Wind gusts over 140 km/h caused widespread structural damage in Namkhana Delta Sector.
WB03.outcome: National disaster response restored essential lifelines.
